messages:
amber.li: Heads up — KMS audit found ~24 service-account keys that haven't been used in >365d. A subset are direct GCP keys (not wrapped in Vault). There's an audit-forwarder gap for eu-west-1 (last log ~48h ago). We should triage and rotate before Thursday. Full CSV uploaded: gs://redwood-sec/audit/orphaned_keys_20260321.csv

sam.patel: can you paste the exact command you used so we can reproduce quickly? want last-used timestamps for each key

amber.li: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=SERVICE@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='json' | jq '.[] | {name,validAfterTime,validBeforeTime}'` then correlate with logging via: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=gae_app OR resource.type=cloud_function' --limit=1000`

jess.huang: assigning myself to sweep services labeled `autodeploy`. i'll do a dry-run (rotate-only, no apply) and post results in this thread within 2h.

mike.choi: i'll prepare a short deny policy (deny `serviceAccounts.keys.create`) at the org level for a 6h maintenance window to prevent new keys while we rotate. i'll also adjust the Vault KMS backend to emit explicit key IDs to the audit stream so we can validate rotation end-to-end.

incident-bot: Created ticket SEC-9876 to track this sweep and any fallout.

amber.li: +1 on deny policy. also flagging terraform modules under `modules/infra/sa-keys` — some modules still create keys by default. if rotation fails, fallback is conversion to workload identity and issuing short-lived tokens via Vault.

sam.patel: proposed schedule: emergency dry-run tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC (low traffic), main 6h rotation window 02:00-08:00 UTC if dry-run looks good, then 24h follow-up sweep next day. volunteers: jess (sweep dry-run), mike (vault & deny), laura (TF changes & PRs). need one more to own post-rotation validation.

laura.kim: i can own the terraform changes and PR approvals. i'll run `terraform state pull` to find any embedded keys and open removals/retros if found.

amber.li: short checklist to keep in thread:
- snapshot current key list and upload to secure bucket
- dry-run rotate for a small subset (autodeploy) and validate services
- apply deny policy during main window
- rotate remaining keys via Vault/KMS workflow (rotate -> wrap -> revoke old)
- update terraform modules & apply PRs
- validate audit logs show `key_id` on each access event
- close SEC-9876 and attach postmortem notes

mike.choi: audit-forwarder snippet i pulled — looks like a brief reset then retry, but want someone to confirm we didn't silently drop events:
```
ts: 2026-03-19T03:10:22Z - audit-forwarder: connection reset to eu-west-1
ts: 2026-03-19T03:10:24Z - audit-forwarder: retry success
```
we need to check the outbound queue for discarded batches and replay if possible.

amber.li: jess — can you create a synthetic key and exercise create/read/delete to ensure forwarder logs the `key_id` end-to-end before we start rotating customer-facing keys?

jess.huang: on it. i'll run synthetic in a sandbox project and post a trace with trace IDs in this thread (will include `trace/` link). also added runbook link: https://go/redwood/sec/runbooks/kms-orphan-rotation

sam.patel: i'll tag rotated resources with `sec:rotation=mar2026` so we can query them easily during postmortem. i'll also prepare a short rollback playbook if any service fails to reconnect (re-create old key -> revert deny policy).

amber.li: noted. if no objections we'll start the dry-run in ~90m. call out if you need additional permissions.

deploy-bot: CI job 4589 flagged: found a literal `serviceAccountKey` in `infra/legacy-deploy/config.yaml` — file has been added to SEC-9876.

jess.huang: opening PR now to remove the literal and swap to a vault reference.

amber.li: thanks everyone. please add any deviations or fallout to SEC-9876. we'll capture lessons learned and update the runbook after the sweep.
